newObservedEntry.how: Concrete ownedConnection and observeOwnedConnection wrap only sockets created by their owning dialer. They retain the net.Conn interface and delegate ordinary I/O while Close tracks actual closure and retains failed-close ownership for bounded retry. The raw variant additionally preserves failures observed by the SDK or cancellation hook through serial accounting; later successful physical closure does not silently erase that failure.
newObservedEntry.why: NATS and TLS may close a socket before outer cleanup. An outer owner must report those actual failures and retain its exact socket without adopting another connection.
newObservedEntry.tradeoffs: Using the bare net.Conn and only its final Close result is simpler but loses earlier SDK/cancellation failure and retry ownership. Wrapping adds synchronization, failure accounting and cancellation-hook join obligations. Test injection is restricted to already minted real sockets. Normal local Close syscalls must complete; this is not a generic closer, sandbox or guarantee of preempting a blocked syscall.
newObservedEntry.qualificationLimit: Observed source and component controls only; no phase/native/Compose qualification.

existingEntryEdits.operation: append how, locations, evidence and revision preserving previous fields
existingEntryEdits.appendHow: OwnerBridgeServer.Run acquires its actual service lease before starting exactly one bounded Bootstrap operation. Authenticated NATS can report starting only after actual admission and protected preparation mark that private operation entered. Run cancels and joins the exact operation before cleanup; joined completion preserves its actual failure, including concrete cleanup owners. A receipt revalidates the bound owner/profile outside operation locks before one accepted frame. Disconnected receipt I/O is nonfatal; changed enrollment is a core admission failure.
existingEntryEdits.appendTradeoffs: Synchronous Bootstrap followed by service subscription is simpler but cannot report genuine starting while startup is in progress. The private operation adds cancellation/join and enrollment revalidation costs; blocked synchronous local filesystem calls remain an explicit timing limit. Receipt-only output conveys past request acceptance and leaves current state unknown; NATS remains the current-status authority.
existingEntryEdits.limits: Do not turn existing historical failed CLI or native qualifications into current acceptance.

existingEntryEdits.operation: append raw/team cleanup qualification distinction and locations
existingEntryEdits.appendHow: The deployment raw dialer used by historical Probe/Observe and declared Team TLS connections owns only its DialContext sockets. It retains exact failures from owner/SDK/cancellation and concrete RawTransportCleanupError retry state. Probe, Observe and Team clear successful facts on any reported cleanup failure. Team transport remains separate from enrolled local TLS-first authentication; do not equate the two authority policies.
existingEntryEdits.appendTradeoffs: The bare standard NATS dialer is simpler but cannot preserve the exact failed cleanup owner. Raw/socket component fault controls and caller source invalidation do not claim forced full-caller fault injection or native Darwin/Compose acceptance.
